anchor.use: ridge mathematical architecture and explicitly authorized preoutcome constants only; no hierarchy/overlay or later configuration/result

augmented: same B plus exact inherited source Phi coordinates, scalar/vector identity mapping unchanged
baseline: exact immutable ten B coordinates; no new baseline features
daily_score: mean D within identity-day, then equal mean over supported context identity-days; missing/stale unsupported not zero; no cohort selection
evaluation: all frozen source decision slots with complete current features and future response windows; model fit unchanged for seven days; prediction is emitted at decision before its label matures; all raw-domain last immature labels censored
fairness: only Phi differs; common intersection of feature/B/response validity for BOTH fits/evaluation; same training index/response/identity weights/B standardizers/refit/model penalties

ridge.objective: weighted MSE with total training weight 1 + ridge penalty

standardization.predictors: per-leaf causal training weighted mean/sd, B statistics shared exactly; floor1e-12; zero-variance coordinate0 with auditflag
standardization.response: same causal training weighted mean/sd; floor1e-12; label and prediction clip[-8,8]

training.labels: decision previous UTC day; maturity strictly before refit; decision+245min strictly before refit
training.minimum_prefix: full56calendar-day domain present, missing rows not invented; at least one valid sampled event; zero variance recorded
training.refit_origin: domain start+56d at UTC midnight; subsequent weekly boundaries
training.weighting: equal total weight per supported identity, equal valid event weights within identity
